notes: Environmental science machines: 8 configurations from 4 manufacturers (Stirling Ultracold x3, Martin Christ x3, Linkam, JULABO); none duplicates the catalog (data/cryostats: Labconco FreeZone 6, Entech 7200A, Linkam LTS120/THMS600/THMSG600/DSC600, Neslab RTE740, Retsch CryoMill etc.) or peer v4 outputs (PHC MDF-DU702VH, Thermo TSX, Christ Epsilon 2-4/2-6D, Helmer iBF125). Celsius converted exactly ((C+273.15) x 1000 mK). Absences (install not_available) are recorded only where a full specification chapter/table was read (Stirling manuals section 9, Christ manuals chapter 10, JULABO technical data, Linkam specification list). Freeze dryers: these LSCbasic configurations use unheated shelves, so temperature.range is the single documented product-space temperature during freezing in the condenser chamber (Alpha 1-2: approx. -20 C from technical data; Alpha 1-4 / 2-4: approx. -20 C / -40 C from the manual glossary for single- / double-stage systems), lo = hi; the condenser minimum is in temperature.condenser.min. Upright freezer sample.height.max is the cabinet interior height (shelves subdivide it). ULT25NEU temperature.gradient is the full +/-3 C uniformity spread (6 C). Linkam cooling-rate range is the LNP96 pump rating. Not covered because sources could not be reached: ice-core archive walk-in freezers / cold labs (custom facilities), cryogenic vacuum water-extraction lines (custom glass lines), Markes TT24-7xr / UNITY-xr cryogen-free preconcentrators (spec sheets behind a contact form), DMT SPIN ice-nucleation chamber, AIDA (facility, not commercial). Tavily and WebSearch were unavailable (plan / turn limits); manufacturer pages and PDFs were read with WebFetch, and PDF text with pdftotext on the WebFetch-cached copies. Quotes from multi-column PDF tables are given in reading order (label then value) as extracted. accessed 2026-11-01.
